    Curaprox Aligner Foam 40ml

    $29.00
    Unit price /
    Unavailable
    View details
    • Material: Aqua, Propylene Glycol, Polyglyceryl-3 Caprate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Hydroxyapatite, Xylitol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Sodium Gluconate, Levulinic Acid, Aroma, Sodium Hydroxide, Cyclodextrin, Glycerin, Sodium Levulinate, Potassium Sorbate, Magnolol, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Sodium Benzoate, Citrus Aurantium Amara Fruit Extract, Sucralose, Amyloglucosidase, Glucose Oxidase, Polylysine, Propyl Gallate, Limonene.
    • Qualities: Remineralization support, Moisture retention, Plaque fighting ingredients, Protective film forming action, and Daily use suitability for aligners, retainers, and mouth guards.
    • Purpose: Helps protect teeth under aligners, retainers, and mouth guards by supporting plaque control, moisture balance, and enamel remineralization.
    • Quantity: 40ml
    • Country of Manufacture: Germany 
    • Package Include: Curaprox Aligner Foam 40ml

    Curaprox Aligner Foam 40ml is an oral care foam designed for use with aligners, retainers, and mouth guards. It helps support cleaner tooth surfaces under removable orthodontic appliances while assisting with plaque control, moisture balance, and enamel care. This formula is suitable for adults and may also be used by children under a dentist’s recommendation.

    The formula contains hydroxyapatite to support enamel remineralization and help protect exposed tooth surfaces, while hyaluronic acid helps maintain moisture and create a protective film over the teeth. It also includes xylitol, magnolol, and a combination of Citrox®, cyclodextrin, and polylysine to support a cleaner oral environment during aligner wear. The enzymatic system helps reinforce the natural protective role of saliva and supports daily oral hygiene for orthodontic patients.

    Curaprox Aligner Foam can be applied directly inside the aligner after brushing, or placed in the mouth and spread over the teeth before spitting out. It is intended for daily use as part of an oral care routine for patients wearing clear aligners, retainers, or similar oral appliances.
